insights.summary: The agent successfully implemented the requested performance optimization by making a CPU-to-GPU bitmask transfer asynchronous. It demonstrated strong systematic behavior, including writing custom verification scripts and handling environment limitations gracefully. The only significant issue was the inclusion of unrelated repository changes in the final commit.
strengths: Excellent response to environment limitations (no CUDA).
Clear documentation of the optimization impact.
weaknesses: Poor git hygiene (staging all changes in a dirty worktree).
Relied heavily on the provided example rather than searching for new optimization sites.
